product_constraint: Same-load d2/d3 API Decode 1.5x to 3x non-MTP, exact full target state/logits and joint Prefill/TTFT/Decode/total reporting.

downward_budget.scope: This bounded prerequisite cannot alone close the 1.30/4.78-second full gap. It removes repeated FC/K/V weight traversals across one accepted prefix, not the dominant target verification arithmetic.

mechanism: After target verification supplies every immutable prefix hidden, first commit batches the contiguous valid input/previous-target-hidden pairs into existing M32 cache-only scratch. Each later commit publishes only its own prepared logical draft length. Target state restoration and observer order remain unchanged.
numerical_contract: Original BF16 MMA FC/K/V and norm/RoPE arithmetic; complete live cache must match independent scalar full draft replay. Future prepared cache rows stay inaccessible on early cancellation/EOS and are overwritten before reuse.
lifetime: No allocation or new stream. Prepared watermark invalidated by rewind/reset/step/append/poison and transaction finish. Preparation synchronizes before readiness; every observer still sees complete target and draft prefix state.
reference_translation: Reuse the already admitted shifted-target-hidden batched initialization dataflow; independent rows require no Q/O/MLP execution. No new external source or dependency.
validation: One fixed implementation plus at most one correctness repair. Full P65 prefix/state/logit/cache/transaction/cancel/failure oracle, then immediate same P65/8K/40K d2 API. Greater than 3% slowdown stops; neutral removes. Useful direction unlocks d3. No batching-size, draft-length or layout scan.
expiry: Useful dependency returns in next complete verifier API composition or is archived. No production or goal-attainment claim from a small gain.
